ambiguity: Almost never misread as another object, though in apps with many person-variant icons (filled vs outlined, framed vs unframed) it is easily confused with contact or customer icons.

reasoning: The standard outlined head-and-shoulders bust is universally understood as a person, user profile, contact, or account. It fits tasks centered on updating personal profiles, bios, avatars, or contact records, though tasks involving specific actions with people (calling, emailing, buying a gift) are better served by action or object icons.
